firstPlayerRule: All players roll two dice. The highest roller starts, then play continues to the left.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest roll, those players roll again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Winning Moves-hosted rules PDF listed on winning-moves.com/rules/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "All players roll two dice (use your dice cup if you wish.) Highest roller starts. Play then continues to the left."
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal high rolls.
